register.labelZh: SCREW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: screw down、screw on 和 screw onto 可以幫助你描述蓋子、保護蓋、手柄和其他零件如何固定。；screw up 可以描述犯錯或把計劃弄糟;screw around 則可以描述有人不工作,只顧胡鬧浪費時間。；screw somebody out of something 表示某人被騙走東西;screw something out of somebody 則表示有人在壓力或威脅下被迫交出某物。；screw up your courage 表示迫使自己鼓起勇氣行動;screw somebody up 則描述較嚴重而持久的心理影響。
register.summaryEn: Screw down, screw on and screw onto help you give practical instructions about lids, covers, handles and other parts. Screw up can describe a mistake or a spoiled plan, while screw around can describe people who are wasting time instead of working. Screw somebody out of something shows that someone was cheated. Screw something out of somebody shows that pressure or threats were used to obtain something. Screw up your courage describes making yourself brave enough to act. Screw somebody up describes a much more serious and lasting emotional effect.
